item.title: Spotify expands AI remix and covers project with Merlin partnership
item.description: Spotify says Merlin, which represents more than 30,000 independent labels and distributors, has joined Universal Music Group in backing its upcoming AI-powered remix and covers product. The paid tool will let fans create AI-generated covers and remixes of participating artists’ music while ensuring artists opt in, receive credit, and are compensated.

item.title: Texas halts new data centers as governor calls for audits
item.description: Tech companies and developers have been scouring the U.S. for places to build data centers, and they’ve been drawn to Texas’ loose regulations and seemingly abundant power supply. But even Texas can be pushed to the brink.

item.title: Elon Musk spends half his time talking robots and AI on Tesla earnings calls
item.description: An analysis of the last seven years of Tesla earnings calls shows just little attention Musk pays to Tesla's car business.

item.title: Apple says more ex-employees may have taken confidential data to OpenAI
item.description: Apple says its trade secrets investigation into OpenAI has widened. In a new court filing, Apple claims additional former staff may have retained or accessed confidential information.

item.title: Is the future of data centers portable? Runware builds a pod to find out
item.description: On Tuesday, AI infrastructure company Runware announced the launch of its own modular data center called Sonic Inference Pod.

item.title: EON wants to move the data superhighway from ocean fiber to space lasers
item.description: Endeavor Optical Networks is planning to launch the fastest space laser communications system yet built.

item.title: After killer quarter, Palantir CEO Alex Karp calls AI industry ‘Marxist’
item.description: After a quarter that delivered $1 billion in profit, Palantir CEO Alex Karp on Monday once again warned that AI frontier labs are too untrustworthy for enterprises.

item.title: AWS is helping vibe-coding startup Superblocks, and the implications are big
item.description: AWS now allows vibe-coding tool Superblocks to be embedded into the private clouds of AWS customers. It's another step toward decoupling apps from models.

item.title: Design Arena creators raise $7.9 million to bring taste to AI models
item.description: Design Arena is used by 5.3 million people around the world, providing critical human evaluations to frontier labs.

item.title: Influencers draw backlash for attending OpenAI’s first luxury trip
item.description: OpenAI’s first-ever influencer brand trip is sparking online backlash as tensions over the use of AI continue.

item.title: Apple finally fixed Siri. So why does it feel anticlimactic?
item.description: Apple’s long-awaited AI overhaul finally makes Siri the assistant it was always supposed to be. Yet it arrives at a moment when simply being a capable AI assistant no longer feels revolutionary.

item.title: Congress’ favorite AI tool? ChatGPT
item.description: House spending records show OpenAI's ChatGPT dominates paid AI use on Capitol Hill, with congressional offices relying on the chatbot to draft memos, summarize legislation, and assist constituent communications.

item.title: A Marc Benioff-backed startup thinks AI can solve the AI deployment problem
item.description: June emerged from stealth today with a $20 million pre-seed round to make AI adoption simpler.

item.title: Sam Altman and AI’s decel debate
item.description: On the latest episode of Equity, we discuss why Sam Altman is calling on the industry to "pace the rate of AI development."

item.title: Judge denies xAI’s request to block Minnesota ban on ‘nudify’ apps
item.description: Despite a lawsuit from xAI, a Minnesota ban on apps that allow users to “nudify” images can move forward.

item.title: YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is ‘not healthy’
item.description: Green offered a remarkable apology, saying that "the level of dopamine that I've been getting from interacting with LLMs ... is not healthy for me or good for the world."

item.title: Sam Altman is still making the case for parenting via ChatGPT
item.description: This isn’t the first time a tech CEO has promised that AI can shield users — and specifically users’ morning commutes — from the messiness and inefficiency of human experience.

item.title: This $9 key physically locks your most addictive apps
item.description: This $9 NFC key requires you to physically scan it to unlock distracting apps on your phone.

item.title: OpenAI reportedly finds evidence that more of its agents ran amok
item.description: OpenAI has reportedly found evidence of additional agent misbehavior as it looks into the incident that occurred with Hugging Face.

item.title: India is starting to pay for apps, not just download them
item.description: India's app market generated a record $345 million in Q2.
